Container.Name: Trellis
Container.Overview: Unofficial community Unraid template for Trellis. The Trellis container is pulled directly from its upstream publisher and is not redistributed by this repository.
Container.License: Integration repository: MIT. Trellis/upstream image: not licensed by this repository; upstream metadata says NOASSERTION.
Container.Requires: Before installation, create the host appdata directory and make it writable by UID/GID 10001:10001. See the README. This is an unofficial integration; back up appdata before updates.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Trellis data. The host directory must be writable by UID/GID 10001:10001; see the README before first start.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Trellis web interface. The container port remains 8477.
